items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Haywood say (unintelligible) he's going to play the instrumental solo.

ctx.x: That's just what Eddie Haywood did and so Eddie Haywood had wrote him a song called 'The Black _______.' See, 'Black _______' (inaudible). Eddie Haywood say (unintelligible) he's going to play the instrumental solo. He says, 'Now while I'm playing the instrumental solo, you say 'Oh, play 'The Black _______''!' He say that would make his song sell. I'd do it, you know, but (unintelligible). So he said, (unintelligible). I said, 'Play it, Black _______.' (Laughter.)
That's how Louie used to do his records.
